name: Mixtur
author: ultralazr
description: A subharmonic organ after Oskar Sala's Mixtur-Trautonium. Four dividers play undertones of the key: the key is the top note, and the dividers add notes at 1/n of its frequency below it. Two formant filters turn the result into vowels. It sounds dark, vocal and slightly unearthly. Each divider offers OFF and 1 to 24. The starting values are 1, 2, 3 and 5.
credits: Musica Obscura by ultralazr, from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
